lesson.title: isiXhosa HL Ibanga 1 · Iveki 7 Usuku 1 — isandi esitsha c
lesson.title_en: isiXhosa HL Grade 1 · Week 7 Day 1 — new sound c
lesson.topic: Abahlobo bam nemidlalo · isandi esitsha c (c + a = ca)
lesson.topic_en: My friends and games · new sound c (c + a = ca)
lesson.caps_ref: CAPS isiXhosa HL Gr R-3, printed pages 9, 56, 57, 58, 60
caps_items: p57: RP-14 u-c; RP-19/21 imifanekiso, uqweqwe

voice_note.script: Molo, titshala. Namhlanje sifundisa isandi esitsha esibhalwa ngonobumba c. Esi sisandi esenziwa ngolwimi: incam yolwimi ibekwa emva kwamazinyo aphezulu, iqhwakraze ngokukhawuleza. Akukho moya uphumayo. Into enye ebalulekileyo namhlanje yile: yenza isandi kanye, uze uvumele abafundi basenze ngokwabo, iklasi yonke, emva koko ubize abafundi abambalwa ngabanye, intombazana emva koko inkwenkwe. Musa ukusenza endaweni yabo. Emva koko sidibanisa nezikhamiso: ca, ce, ci, co, cu. Amagama anamhlanje ngala: cela, cula, iculo, cima. Eqeleni, abafundi bafunda ibali elifutshane elithi Iculo. Ekuqaleni kwesifundo, abantwana babalisa iindaba ngomdlalo abawudlale nomhlobo, baze baphendule ngo-ewe okanye hayi. Kuyavuyisa ukusebenza nawe. Hamba kakuhle.
voice_note.script_en: Hello, teacher. Today we teach a new sound, written with the letter c. This is a sound made with the tongue: the tip of the tongue goes behind the top teeth and clicks away quickly. No breath comes out. The one important thing today is this: make the sound once, then let the learners make it themselves, the whole class, then call a few learners one by one, a girl and then a boy. Do not make it for them. Then we join it with the vowels: ca, ce, ci, co, cu. Today's words are: cela, cula, iculo, cima. In the group, learners read a short story called Iculo, The Song. At the start of the lesson, the children tell news about a game they played with a friend, and answer with yes or no. It is a joy to work with you. Go well.

backtranslation.line: Ngaba uyadlala nomhlobo wakho? Phendula ngo-ewe okanye hayi.
backtranslation.says: Are you playing with your friend? Answer with yes or no.
backtranslation.should: Do you play with your friend? Answer yes or no.

backtranslation.line: Qala phezulu ngasekunene, jikela ngasekhohlo, uhle, uphele phantsi ngasekunene.
backtranslation.says: Start at the top on the right, turn to the left, go down, finish at the bottom on the right.
backtranslation.should: Start at the top on the right, curve to the left, go down, finish at the bottom on the right.
